newsitem.title: USA: Rural Cellular gets $140 mln credit deal.
newsitem.headline: Rural Cellular gets $140 mln credit deal.

text.p: Rural Cellular Corp said Thursday it established a $140 million revolving credit facility with a group of banks headed by T.D. Securities (USA) Inc.

The company said the new credit facility will be used to finance construction of the Personal Communications Services (PCS) networks of its Wireless Alliance LLC joint venture, the pending acquisition of Unity Cellular Systems Inc, and the conversion of Rural Cellular's northern Minnesota cellular operations to digital technology.
The transaction is co-managed by BankBoston NA and St. Paul Bank of Cooperatives, RCC's current debt lender.
